title.narrative: SPRING - Strategic Partnership for Resilience, Innovation and New Generation
SPRING - Strategic Partnership for Resilience, Innovation and New Generation

description.narrative: Detta bidrag syftar till att stärka motståndskraften hos företag i Bosnien och Hercegovina samt främja den systematiska konkurrenskraften i landets ekonomi, mitt i alltmer frekventa och oförutsägbara störningar på marknaderna i Europeiska unionen (EU) och Västra Balkan (WB), samtidigt som det skapas anständiga arbetstillfällen och uppmuntras unga, talangfulla och kvalificerade yrkespersoner att stanna kvar i landet.

This contribution is to contribute to strengthening resilience of BIH companies and advancing the systematic competitiveness of the BiH economy amidst increasingly frequent and unpredictable disruptions in the European Union (EU) and Western Balkans (WB) markets, while creating decent working employment opportunities and encourage young talented and skilled professionals to remain in the country.

The overall objective of this contribution is to contribute to strengthening resilience of BIH companies and advancing the systematic competitiveness of the BiH economy amidst increasingly frequent and unpredictable disruptions in the European Union (EU) and Western Balkans (WB) markets, while creating decent working employment opportunities and encourage young talented and skilled professionals to remain in the country. The contribution further focuses on 4 (four) specific objectives: 1) Foster advanced competitiveness among export oriented companies by increasing added value and creating attractive job opportunities for skilled individuals. 2) Foster a dynamic startup and spinoff ecosystem, with a strong focus on knowledge and technology based business services. In parallel, promote systematic reskilling and upskilling initiatives across the workforce to ensure future oriented competencies and strengthen overall competitiveness of BiH economy. 3) Encourage meaningful collaboration with Swedish companies and organizations at micro and mezzo levels, demonstrating successful partnership models. 4) Develop and disseminate innovative tools and approaches for the systematic support of export oriented and startups/ spinoff companies in BiH, thereby contributing to inclusive and sustainable economic growth.
The contribution will be implemented through of 5 Working packages.
